author: UncleClaude-Hxnter-aKidWolfe
install_msg: Thanks for installing PokéBot! Use `[p]pokeset spawnchannel #channel` to set your spawn channel, then `[p]start` to begin your journey. `[p]pokehelp` lists everything.
name: PokéBot
short: Catch, battle, trade and collect Pokémon — with buttons.
description: Full-featured Pokémon bot powered by PokéAPI. Wild spawns with one-tap ball buttons and a private 'Do I have it?' Pokédex check, a one-command Pokémon Center that heals your whole party and offers to buy anything missing, button-driven battles, trades, raids and shop, Pokéstop dailies, TMs, evolutions and leaderboards.
end_user_data_statement: PokéBot stores, per server, each trainer's Pokémon collection, items, Pokédex, battle record and Pokéstop streak, keyed by Discord user ID. It does not store message content. Data is removed on Red's data deletion request.
